LENG.description: Unbraced Length (LENG). Per-element design unbraced-length data keyed by element number; all fields are optional length/flag values applied directly with no TYPE branching.

LY.description: Unbraced length for buckling about the y-axis (Ly). Optional; defaults to 0.

LZ.description: Unbraced length for buckling about the z-axis (Lz). Optional; defaults to 0.

LB.description: Laterally unbraced length (Lb) for lateral-torsional buckling. Optional; defaults to 0.

bNOTUSE.description: If true, do not consider the laterally unbraced length. Optional; defaults to false.

bAUTOCALC.description: If true, calculate the unbraced lengths automatically by the design code. Optional; defaults to false.

LT.description: Torsional unbraced length (Lt). Optional; defaults to 0.
